name: Aura of Vapor (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental Surge, water subtype

Benefit(s): You possess an aura of thick, cool water vapor within a 30-foot radius. Any fire spell, attack, or effect deals only half damage against creatures and objects within this area.
